svg.title: Buchla Easel Command connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
svg.text: Buchla Easel Command / CONNECTIONS
Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.
INPUTS
OUTPUTS
DATA / POWER / CONTROLS
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
STORED PROGRAM: Program card, Control
TOP CONNECTIONS: Mod osc IN, Mod osc OUT, Inverter IN, Inverter OUT, Complex osc OUT, Preamp IN, Card IN, Mix OUT
SEQUENTIAL VOLTAGE: Trigger, Stages, Pulse 1, Pulse 2, Pulse 3, Pulse 4, Pulse 5
ENVELOPE / PULSER: EG trigger, EG mode, Pulser trigger, Pulser mode
MOD OSCILLATOR: Wave shape, Fine tune, Range, Modulation
COMPLEX OSCILLATOR: Wave shape, Fine tune, Keyboard, Polarity
DUAL LO PASS GATE: Gate source, Mode 1, Mode 2
SEQUENCER VOLTAGES: Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5
ENVELOPE: Attack, Sustain, Decay
PULSER: Period, Period CV
MOD OSC FADERS: Frequency, Freq CV, Mod amount
COMPLEX OSC FADERS: Pitch, Pitch CV, Timbre, Timbre CV
LPG LEVELS: Level 1, CV 1, Level 2, CV 2
MIX / REVERB: Preamp gain, Channel A, Channel B, Reverb, Monitor level, Phones, Master volume
BANANA PATCH POINTS: Pulse, Pressure, Pitch, Mod freq, EG IN, EG OUT, Seq OUT, Random OUT, Pulser OUT, Mod CV, Mod OUT, Pitch CV, Complex OUT, Timbre CV, LPG 1 CV, LPG 2 CV
